title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Public Lighting - SuministroElectrico
description: Electricity supply contract associated with a control center, including tariff, voltage, and consumption by tariff periods (edintalu:SuministroElectrico, subclass of edint-suministro's UtilityContract).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'SuministroElectrico'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

appliesTo.description: Relationship. The UtilitySupplyPoint (CentroDeMando) this contract applies to. Inherited from UtilityContract (edint-suministro).

contractHolder.description: Relationship. The Organization that holds the contract. Inherited from UtilityContract (edint-suministro).

hasRate.description: Relationship. The UtilityRate applied in the contract. Inherited from UtilityContract (edint-suministro).

tension.description: Property. Supply voltage, in volts (edintalu:tension). Simplified from a qudt:QuantityValue.

tarifa.description: Property. Type of electricity tariff applied, e.g. '6.1', '6.2' (edintalu:tarifa).

kwhRenovables.description: Property. Consumption from renewable energy sources with self-consumption systems, in kWh (edintalu:kwhRenovables). Simplified from a qudt:QuantityValue.

tieneConsumo.description: Relationship. Energy consumption record(s) (ConsumoEnergetico) of this supply, zero or more (edintalu:tieneConsumo).
